name: ecommerce-multi-tender-payments
description: Owns the payment plan and its arithmetic. It never moves money and it never holds a balance.
features: Split payments across any number of tenders in a caller-declared order
Gift card and store credit tenders recorded without ever asking what a card is worth
Deposits recorded as ordinary tenders against the same fold
Instalment references recorded as external identifiers only
Partial payments as the normal case, with a short tender partly spent
Outstanding balance computed as a fold over an append-only ledger
Exact integer allocation with largest-remainder distribution
